newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Cyprus dog fight charges dropped.
newsitem.headline: Cyprus dog fight charges dropped.

text.p: Cyprus police on Tuesday dropped charges against four men accused of organising deadly dog fights a day before they were due to appear in court, the Cyprus News Agency (CNA) reported.
The charges followed bloody scenes of a fight involving a pit bull and an alsatian which were shown on television last month.
Quoting an official statement, the CNA said the police could not press charges as the alleged offences took place more than a year ago.
However, because of a public outcry the Attorney General's office was preparing a bill to extend existing legislation.
The private Antenna television station, which showed the footage, said the fight was organised for betting.
